g.aria-label: A red supergiant erupts; dense plasma escapes while captured debris completes shrinking orbits and slowly builds a long-lived dark black hole

svg.text: Most of my work starts messy:
commerce flows full of edge cases,
dashboards that have to stay fast,
or AI agents acting inside live products.
I shape the behavior, build the system underneath,
and automate what should not stay manual.
66% smaller bundle · 3+ apps · ~30% less repeated effort
product foundations behind support, commerce, AI, and identity
notes from systems that survived production
> Start with the customer problem, then make the architecture earn its complexity.
> Break large systems into boundaries people can actually own.
> Ship, observe real usage, and improve what survives contact with production.
